note: Tier 2, the holders question (701.34a). A casts Steady Progress ("Proliferate. Draw a card."); as it resolves A chooses which permanents and players with counters get another counter of each kind they have. Only A's Grizzly Bears have a counter; A chooses them, so they go from one +1/+1 counter (3/3) to two (4/4, 613.4c), then A draws the Forest and the instant goes to the graveyard (608.2n). The position is stipulated (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play.

transitions.note: Steady Progress ({2}{U}, instant) is cast with priority (117.1a, 601.2a); it has no targets or modes. 601.2g, 601.2h: three Islands each add {U} (305.6, 106.4) and pay {2}{U}; the pool is empty again. 117.3c: A receives priority; both pass (implied, 117.4) and the spell resolves, following its instructions in order (608.2c). Proliferate (701.34a): A chooses any number of permanents and/or players that have a counter, a choice made while the effect is applied (608.2d). That choice is the boundary, so the spell is still on the stack (spec 4.2). The question is asked although only A's Bears have a counter (B's Bears and both players have none).

701.34a: the Bears are chosen and get one additional counter of each kind already there: a second +1/+1 counter (122.1a), so the 2/2 is 4/4 (613.4c). Then "Draw a card" (608.2c, 121.1): A draws the top card of A's library, the Forest. 608.2n: as the final part of its resolution the instant goes to its owner's graveyard. 704.3: no state-based action applies (A's library being empty matters only on a draw from it, 704.5b). 117.3b: the active player receives priority; the record ends here.
